true_answer: Events that have a space-like separation will be simultaneous in some frame of reference, and there is no frame of reference in which they do not have a spatial separation. Diﬀerent observers may calculate diﬀerent distances and diﬀerent time intervals between two events, but the invariant interval between the events is independent of the observer and their velocity.
